title: Factory preset assets — categorized JSON files
description:
Author categorized, gain-conscious factory preset JSON assets under Resources/Presets/ for Rhythm, Lead, Post-Amp, DI-Keyed, Bass, and Diagnostic categories (CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §24).

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §24 Factory Presets categories
- Source/Profiles.h profile names/indices from j.1
- Source/ParameterIDs.h for stable parameter id strings to embed in JSON
- Source/StateManager factory preset loader expectations (read-only Resources/Presets/)
- Any existing Resources/Presets/ placeholder from phase A

Create at least these factory preset files (names match phase expected_changed_files):
- Resources/Presets/Rhythm_ModernTight.json — tight rhythm / palm-mute oriented, deep floor, strong attack guard; references Tight Rhythm profile
- Resources/Presets/Lead_SingingSustain.json — lead sustain / soft floor; Lead Sustain profile
- Resources/Presets/PostAmp_HissSuppression.json — post-amp hiss control, Hiss Curtain friendly; Post-Amp Hiss profile
- Resources/Presets/DIKeyed_Rhythm.json — external key / alignment / lookahead conscious; DI-Keyed Reamp profile
- Resources/Presets/Bass_ActiveNoiseControl.json — active bass, hum rejection, moderate sustain; Active Bass profile
- Resources/Presets/Diag_LearnMyRig.json — diagnostic starting point for Noise Learn / inspect rejected; safe defaults, not extreme mute

JSON schema (consistent across files):
- meta: name, category, description, schema_version, profileId/profileName, optional tuningId
- parameters: object map of ParameterIDs string → value (float/int/bool/choice index as numbers)
- Gain-conscious: outputTrim near 0 dB; avoid extreme output boosts; floors and thresholds intentional but usable
- Valid UTF-8 JSON parseable by juce::JSON::parse / nlohmann-free standard parsers

Optional: add a small category marker field so the preset browser can group entries. Do not edit C++ sources or CMake in this task.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: Resources/Presets/Rhythm_ModernTight.json exists and is valid JSON
Resources/Presets/DIKeyed_Rhythm.json exists and is valid JSON
Resources/Presets/Diag_LearnMyRig.json exists and is valid JSON
Each preset JSON includes meta name/category/schema_version and a parameters map keyed by parameter IDs
Presets are gain-conscious (no extreme outputTrim boosts) and reference a profile id/name
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: embed binary blobs or non-JSON formats

allowed: use a shared JSON meta+parameters shape across all six files
choose conservative default numeric values consistent with named category intent
include category string for browser grouping
forbidden: implement C++ loaders or GUI in this task
rename files away from the expected factory names
store absolute machine-local paths inside presets
